title: MultiSoc-4D: A Benchmark for Diagnosing Instruction-Induced Label Collapse in Closed-Set LLM Annotation of Bengali Social Media

bias_targets.methodology: Comparing LLM-generated label distributions against human gold-standard annotations using a Bias Ratio metric and inter-annotator agreement (Fleiss' Kappa) to quantify the systemic over-representation of fallback labels (Other, Neutral, No) and the under-detection of informative minority classes.

Calculating the False Negative Rate (FNR) on Hateful and Sarcasm detection tasks to measure the tendency of instruction-tuned LLMs to underestimate implicit toxicity and default to sanitized, non-hateful, or non-sarcastic predictions.
